blocks.text: MANDAUE CITY, Cebu — The Mandaue City Council is set to invite the Visayan Electric Co. (VECO) and the National Grid Corporation of the Philippines (NGCP) to its next session to seek clarifications on the rotational brownouts that continue to affect parts of Cebu. The council also passed a resolution urging VECO to follow its published schedule of rotational power interruptions, as residents and businesses have reported that actual outages do not always follow the announced schedules. Councilor Carlo Fortuna said that the council wants to obtain official information from VECO and NGCP on the state of Cebu’s power situation, including […]...
